WITH flare_concepts AS (SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (36674930,1340341) UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (36674930,1340341)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN flare_concepts fc ON co.condition_concept_id=fc.concept_id

WITH ult_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 1167322 AS ingredient_id UNION ALL SELECT 19017742 UNION ALL SELECT 1151422 UNION ALL SELECT 40226208 UNION ALL SELECT 35605425
), ult_desc AS (
  SELECT ca.ancestor_concept_id AS ingredient_id, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca JOIN ult_ingredients ui ON ui.ingredient_id=ca.ancestor_concept_id
), ult_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, CAST(de.drug_exposure_start_date AS date) AS start_date, d.ingredient_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de JOIN ult_desc d ON de.drug_concept_id=d.drug_concept_id
), first_date AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(start_date) AS index_date FROM ult_exposures GROUP BY person_id
), first_choice AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, f.index_date, MIN(e.ingredient_id) AS ingredient_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ingredient_id) AS n_ingredients
  FROM first_date f JOIN ult_exposures e ON e.person_id=f.person_id AND e.start_date=f.index_date
  GROUP BY e.person_id, f.index_date
), cohort AS (
  SELECT fc.person_id, fc.index_date, fc.ingredient_id,
         CASE WHEN fc.ingredient_id=1167322 THEN 'allopurinol' WHEN fc.ingredient_id=19017742 THEN 'febuxostat' END AS drug
  FROM first_choice fc
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id=fc.person_id
    AND fc.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day,365,fc.index_date)
  WHERE fc.n_ingredients=1 AND fc.ingredient_id IN (1167322,19017742)
), flare_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (36674930,1340341)
  UNION SELECT 36674930 UNION SELECT 1340341
), outcomes AS (
  SELECT c.person_id, c.drug, c.index_date,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN flare_concepts fc ON fc.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
      WHERE co.person_id=c.person_id AND co.condition_start_date > c.index_date AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS any_flare_code,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN flare_concepts fc ON fc.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
      WHERE co.person_id=c.person_id AND co.condition_start_date > c.index_date AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
    ) AS flare_code_count,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.measurement m WHERE m.person_id=c.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id=3037556 AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL AND m.measurement_date > c.index_date AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_ua,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM omop.measurement m WHERE m.person_id=c.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id=3037556 AND m.value_as_number < 6.0 AND m.measurement_date > c.index_date AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date)
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ever_ua_lt6,
    (SELECT TOP 1 m.value_as_number FROM omop.measurement m WHERE m.person_id=c.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id=3037556 AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL AND m.measurement_date > c.index_date AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date) ORDER BY m.measurement_date DESC, m.measurement_id DESC) AS last_ua,
    (SELECT TOP 1 m.measurement_date FROM omop.measurement m WHERE m.person_id=c.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id=3037556 AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL AND m.measurement_date > c.index_date AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day,365,c.index_date) ORDER BY m.measurement_date DESC, m.measurement_id DESC) AS last_ua_date
  FROM cohort c
)
SELECT drug,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(any_flare_code) AS n_any_flare_code,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(any_flare_code)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct_any_flare_code,
       SUM(flare_code_count) AS total_flare_codes,
       CAST(1.0*SUM(flare_code_count)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(8,3)) AS flare_codes_per_patient,
       SUM(has_ua) AS n_with_ua_12m,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(has_ua)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct_with_ua_12m,
       SUM(CASE WHEN last_ua < 6.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_last_ua_lt6,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN last_ua < 6.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_ua),0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct_last_ua_lt6_among_tested,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN last_ua < 6.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct_last_ua_lt6_all,
       SUM(ever_ua_lt6) AS n_ever_ua_lt6,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(ever_ua_lt6)/NULLIF(SUM(has_ua),0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct_ever_ua_lt6_among_tested
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY drug
ORDER BY drug
